I regularly contribute to the organization of conferences, workshops and conference sessions in economic theory, game theory and social choice.

## Current and forthcoming

1. **[19th Meeting of the Society for Social Choice and Welfare (SSCW 2028)](https://www.gate.cnrs.fr/condorcet/)** — Co-organizer. Université Lumière Lyon 2, Lyon, France, June–July 2028. The conference will be hosted at Université Lumière Lyon 2, with organization by GATE Lyon Saint-Étienne and Université Jean Monnet and support from the PEPR CONDORCET.

1. **[France–Spain Meeting on Microeconomic Theory](https://sites.google.com/go.ugr.es/france-spain-mit)** — Member of the Scientific Committee. Annual France–Spain meeting in microeconomic theory.

1. **[Workshop in Economic Theory](https://economic-theory-stetienne.github.io/)** — Co-organizer. Saint-Étienne, France, September 8, 2026.

## SAET sessions — Axiomatization in Economic Theory

1. **[SAET 2025](https://saet.uiowa.edu/2025-conference/)** — Co-organizer with Federica Ceron of the session *Axiomatization in Economic Theory*. Ischia, Italy, June 29–July 5, 2025.

1. **[SAET 2024](https://saet.uiowa.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/18/2024/08/2024SantiagoConferenceProgramSAET.pdf)** — Organizer, with Federica Ceron as co-organizer, of two sessions on *Axiomatizations in Economic Theory*. Santiago, Chile, January 8–11, 2024.

1. **[SAET 2023](https://sites.google.com/view/saet2023/home)** — Organizer of a session on *Axiomatization in Economic Theory*. Paris, France, July 17–21, 2023.
